name: vmodal-trend-radar
description: Measure fashion trends over time in VModal street-style video collections: for each trend item (garment, color, print, accessory) search every season / sub-collection, verify every counted scene on real frames, and build an item × period matrix that says what is rising, fading, stable or evergreen, with proof frames. Use when the user asks "what's trending", "trend radar", "is X rising / fading", "evergreen pieces", or compares seasons or street vs brand, e.g. "Run a Milan trend radar for suede and leopard. Collection: fashion_milan". Requires the vmodal MCP and the vmodal-find skill.
